newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent per lb. Lower cash beef prices plus prospects for ample supply of cattle this summer should keep futures under pressure.
FEEDER CATTLE - Mixed. Expected lower live cattle may pull feeders down. However, forecasts for big U.S. corn crop bullish for placements and feeder prices.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to down 0.100 cent. Expected lower cash ogs at Midwest markets plus lower pork prices should take futures down early.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. May follow hogs lower. However, higher futures needed to encourage rebuilding of low storage stocks.
